description: This PHP class defines the I18NLanguage entity for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_i18n_language' database table. It provides properties and methods for managing language records including id, name, code, enabled state, added state, and modification timestamp. It also uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping and includes constants for language status states.

classes.name: I18NLanguage
classes.description: Entity class representing a language in the system, with properties for id, name, code, enabled status, added status, and modification date, along with relevant getters and setters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the language.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the language.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the language.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the language.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the language.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code of the language.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the language is enabled.

methods.name: isAdded
methods.description: Checks if the language is marked as added.

methods.name: setAdded
methods.description: Sets the added status of the language.
